source_label: Percent Household Head and Spouse Own House[1]
mapping_status: official 2018 questionnaire defines a continuous percentage share; route and house/member-slot interpretation reviewed
caveat: Official 2018 HA&I questionnaire asks what percentage of a specific house's property rights belongs to each listed family-member slot. This is a continuous percent response, not a categorical value label. Fields repeat by house/person and follow roster-dependent routes; preserve slot identity and denominators, do not sum across incompatible or missing slots, and do not infer respondent-level ownership without a prespecified derivation. The questionnaire instructs interviewers to enter 100% for the 'Other' case when the house is unrelated to the respondent/spouse or listed relatives/friends. Confirm special codes and route eligibility in the authorized release before analysis.

mapping_status: official 2018 questionnaire defines a continuous percentage share; route and house/member-slot interpretation reviewed
caveat: Official 2018 HA&I questionnaire asks what percentage of a specific house's property rights belongs to each listed family-member slot. This is a continuous percent response, not a categorical value label. Fields repeat by house/person and follow roster-dependent routes; preserve slot identity and denominators, do not sum across incompatible or missing slots, and do not infer respondent-level ownership without a prespecified derivation. The questionnaire instructs interviewers to enter 100% for the 'Other' case when the house is unrelated to the respondent/spouse or listed relatives/friends. Confirm special codes and route eligibility in the authorized release before analysis.

The questionnaire instructs interviewers to enter 100% for the 'Other' case when the house is unrelated to the respondent/spouse or listed relatives/friends. Confirm special codes and route eligibility in the authorized release before analysis.
